name: Chuinb Skill
headline: 行业速成大师 skill for rapid industry mastery
short_description: Rapidly gain industry expertise with this Claude Code skill. Ideal for operations teams needing quick insights into new sectors. Connects to Claude for accelerated learning and decision-making.
author: yizhiyanhua-ai

sections.overview:
chuinb-skill automates industry learning by searching current information, downloading relevant images and videos, and generating AI concept diagrams to create comprehensive study notes. The skill simplifies complex domains into clear explanations, teaches industry terminology, introduces key figures and case studies, and provides flashcards for retention. Operations teams, career changers, and professionals preparing for industry-specific meetings can quickly build credible knowledge across unfamiliar sectors without manual research.
Preparing for investor meetings in unfamiliar industries like blockchain or venture capital
Career transitions requiring rapid domain knowledge in new sectors
Building industry credibility for client or partnership conversations
Creating comprehensive learning materials with embedded diagrams and media
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/yizhiyanhua-ai/chuinb-skill`
sections.usage:
```
Use the chuinb-skill to quickly onboard me into [INDUSTRY SECTOR]. Provide a concise but comprehensive overview covering: 1) Key industry trends in [YEAR], 2) Top 3 challenges faced by [ROLE/DEPARTMENT] teams, 3) Emerging technologies disrupting the sector, and 4) Critical KPIs to track performance. Prioritize insights from [SPECIFIC SOURCE TYPE, e.g., recent reports, competitor analysis, or regulatory changes]. Format the response as a structured report with clear headings and bullet points for quick reference.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
